script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Our hero, JAMES (30s), a driven painter, stands before a blank canvas, the sun streaming in through the windows. His wife, EMMA (30s), enters from the kitchen.

EMMA
James, I've made us lunch. Can't you take a break?

JAMES (absently)
Not now, love. I need to finish this.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

James works tirelessly, day in and day out. He's focused on creating a masterpiece that will grant him recognition and success in the art world. But his obsession is taking a toll on him and those around him.

---

INT. EMMA'S STUDIO - NIGHT

Emma sits in her own art studio, painting. She looks at her husband, who has become consumed by his work, with concern.

EMMA
I wish you could see the world beyond your canvas, James.

---

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

James' younger brother, MIKE (28), visits with his family. He's successful in his career and has a balanced family life. James' ambition stings him.

MIKE
(laughs)
You'll never make it, Jimbo. Lighten up.

---

INT. JAMES' STUDIO - NIGHT

James continues to work late into the night, neglecting his family and their needs.

---

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Emma confronts James about his obsession.

EMMA
Why can't you be happy with what you have, James? Your family, your home, your art?

JAMES
I want more. I need to create something that matters.

---

INT. ART GALLERY - DAY

James finally completes his masterpiece and submits it to an prestigious art gallery. He's rejected.

---

INT. JAMES' STUDIO - NIGHT

James is devastated. His ambition turns to frustration and anger.

---

INT. EMMA'S STUDIO - DAY

Emma offers James a solution. She encourages him to teach art to children and inspire them to follow their dreams.

---

INT. CLASSROOM - DAY

James begins teaching, and he discovers the joy of sharing his passion with others. He learns that recognition and success aren't the only measures of a fulfilled life.

---

EXT. PARK - DAY

James and Emma enjoy a picnic with their children, watching them play in the park. James looks content, and his obsession has given way to appreciation.

EMMA
I'm proud of you, James.

JAMES
I'm proud of us.

FADE OUT.

---

END OF SCREENPLAY.
